stories.title: Decision on £200m Parc Adfer carbon capture plant deferred as English villages not consulted
stories.summary: A decision on a £200 million carbon capture facility that would create Wales’ first carbon negative waste to energy plant has been deferred after residents in England were not consulted. stories.summary: A Senedd Member who experienced the care system as a child has spoken in favour of creating family drug and alcohol courts in Wales. stories.title: World Mental Health Day: charity shares stories of two young Flintshire women
stories.summary: A care leaver from Holywell and a young carer from Broughton are among 514 young people supported by charity WeMindTheGap in 2025/26. The charity has shared their stories, with names changed, to mark World Mental Health Day today, Saturday October 10. Rachel, 18, a care leaver from Holywell, receives professional support for anxiety and depression.

stories.summary: Senedd Members have backed calls to review Wales’ funding formula to increase fairness and transparency in how the nation is financed. stories.title: Weekend story sessions for young children begin at Abakhan bookshop in Mostyn
stories.summary: A children’s bookshop at Abakhan in Mostyn has started weekend storytelling sessions for young children and their families. Curious Little Imagineers is running the sessions, called Cosy Cabin Tales, every Saturday and Sunday at 10.15am. Each one lasts between 20 and 30 minutes.
